releases.displayName: Unusual Findings | Free “Vinny’s Diary” Update Is Available Now

items.text: We are thrilled to announce that a major content update for Unusual Findings is available right now! The Vinny’s Diary Update will add a bunch of fresh new gameplay content as well as quality-of-life updates to the bodacious adventure from developer Epic Llama Games for free!

notes.title: Details of the upcoming Unusual Findings Vinny’s Diary Update

items.text: Dive deeper into this quintessential action adventure by accessing Vinny’s Diary from the inventory. Vinny, one of the three main characters from Unusual Findings, will share hints on how to complete and solve puzzles via his thoughts in his diary as well as providing a little extra lore from the game. Players can also use the ‘give more hints’ button until the hints and advice are replaced by direct instructions for those who need a little extra help.
Improved controls (requested by the community).
Various fixes and QOL improvements
The inclusion of the final round of names for the Kickstarter backers who didn't make it into the release version.

Thank you for all your feedback and support — it truly helps us keep improving the game. And a special thanks to everyone who has purchased and continues to play Unusual Findings. We appreciate every one of you! Let us know what you think about the game by writing a review here on Steam, posting it in the Discussions, or chat with us on the official ESDigital social media accounts. We'll keep working to improve this game and provide you with a better game experience in near future! Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

releases.displayName: Memory Lost: Chapter One Receives Huge Content Update!

items.text: We are happy to announce a massive update to Memory Lost: Chapter One! You can now play the entire first chapter of the full game by heading to Memory Lost: Chapter One and jumping straight into the fresh, updated gameplay and seeing what’s in store for the full launch next year!

The Memory Lost: Chapter One was first launched in December 2022 and has delighted shooter fans with its innovative combat mechanics and fast-paced gameplay. Over the past 12 months, we’ve been gathering community and players feedback to support the ongoing development of the full game. As part of the continued development journey of Memory Lost, we will continue to use the valuable feedback gathered from the Memory Lost: Chapter One to enhance the full game experience.
Try Chapter One for free and wishlist Memory Lost!
Thought we were done? No, We've barely begun!

We have collected (and are collecting) all your feedback and suggestions, analyze them and continue to improve the Unusual Findings game. In the new update, we tried to take into account the comments of those who faced difficulties with moving the characters. So that you don't accidentally click on objects, trying to bring guys from one side of the screen to the other, we added moving to the right mouse button. Now it's responsible ONLY for the movement of the heroes.
You can still move and open the action wheel by clicking the left mouse button, so those who were more accustomed to such control scheme will be able to use it as before!

And we also worked day and night to polish and release versions of Unusual Findings for macOS and Linux. This, of course, was in the plans, but only now we were able to get to it properly and fully release these versions. Hurray! ^^
Naturally, there are many other minor fixes, including some bugs that have been eliminated (we hope that's all, but if you come across those that we haven't caught, be sure to write to us!).

notes.title: Well, let's remind you about pleasant things

items.text: First, you can nominate our game. It's not necessary, but it would be nice for us, so if you feel that Unusual Findings is worthy of one of the nominations - feel free to vote!
Third, come to our Twitter, we will soon summarize the results of the contest, but now you still have a chance to participate.

notes.title: Once again, both Epic Llama Games and ESDigital Games would like to express our deepest gratitude to you for your support!

items.text: THANK YOU! ^^
Hello friends!

The release is just around the corner! On October 12th you'll be able to play Unusual Findings and feel the atmosphere of the 80's. Now we are putting the finishing touches or as they say, "polishing the game". The devil is in the details, so we have paid them special attention. We finalized the lighting, backgrounds, as well as most of the models, so all the locations and characters there look harmonious.

For example, the city got closer, and the night was filled with stars and a huge moon! And there have also been many such small but very significant changes. You can experience them right now, because we updated the demo version, and now it fully corresponds to the latest version of the game!
That doesn't mean we're done, we're still improving everything our insatiable hands can reach, and we hope you'll get more than just a "polished game" at release!
Hey everyone,
We're extremely grateful for your contributions and support! And we have an update for our Kickstarter campaign.

So far we’ve reached 40% of our goal and everyday while watching the numbers rise, we were happy to see so much support from you. So far we want to address this message to everybody who showed their interest and love to our game. A BIG HUG FOR EVERYBODY!
During the campaign we will reveal some details about in-game characters, places and mechanics. The Bull is the special guest on today's update!

notes.title: The Bull? WHO IS THE BULL?! MOOO?

items.text: After watching our trailer (if you haven’t done that yet, we strongly recommend you to do so. It will be worth it, we can promise you that), you probably noticed the armed manly man. This is the Bull and he has the charm.

The Bull is a professional hitman working for different mobster families, a one man army, a force to be reckoned with, full of scars and bandages yet he seems to be indestructible. The quintessential 80s action hero, someone that does not belong to the calm town of Southplains. Maybe that's why he lives in a trailer on the edge of the town.

Few things are known about The Bull's past. He was raised on the streets and molded by them, he doesn’t like cops, nor authority. The money he gets from his jobs is usually spent on weapons, whisky and videogames. And thanks to that last thing he bonded with Vinny, Nick and Tony. For someone of such a violent lifestyle, The Bull is very kind with the kids, cares about them and considers them their real friends. If someone is prepared for an alien invasion that’s The Bull. No one would want to mess with, because when you mess with The Bull, you get the horns.
We have a new in-game track for you. An increasingly overwhelming track, where the unknown is marching forward to an eminent meeting with three kids standing in awe.
It will also appear on the campaign page. Enjoy!

notes.title: RALF figurine? Here are some details!

items.text: It is a 20cm high detailed and hand painted figurine made of liquid two-component polyurethane plastic (Smooth-Cast 305).

We want to unite fans of retro and classic quests in the community and would be very grateful for your help. Therefore, we have prepared a surprise! With your help we already get 100 retweets on the dedicated TWEET and soon we will reveal a photo of the RALF figurine, which will be available for purchase separate from the Kickstarter tier as well!
But we'd love for you to make more retweets and help us tell more people about our game!
Our whole team is working really hard everyday to bring you the good news, a better value and the best game! Stay tuned for a lot more to discover!
